facts.claim: TASK-531 and TASK-532 carried requires edges to RESEARCH-530 and OUTCOME-520, so neither could start before those nodes were verified.

RESEARCH-530's audit is blocked by the open high finding FIND-SCALE on ASSET-SCANNER/STORE/RESOURCE, and GATE-529 (OUTCOME-520) is blocked by the same finding on ASSET-STORE; the runtime blocks any audit whose impacted assets intersect an open high finding.
FIND-SCALE describes unbounded frontier growth, repeated enumeration, monolithic publication and scheduler progress; only TASK-531/532 implementation evidence at 100k/1M can resolve it.
The research decision record explicitly asked for a bounded replan that keeps a proof dependency before production implementation instead of unblocking production by report alone.

findings.claim: The storage rung cannot start under the current edges because its prerequisites' verification depends on evidence only the storage rung can produce.
findings.change: Retype TASK-531→RESEARCH-530, TASK-531→OUTCOME-520 and TASK-532→OUTCOME-520 from requires to integration-requires; add the research decision, design candidate and recovery/space records to both tasks' required context.
findings.rationale: integration-requires lets the tasks start while still forbidding their audit pass until the research and OUTCOME-520 are verified, which is the proof dependency the research asked to preserve; no gate, acceptance criterion, finding or increment boundary is weakened.

findings.claim: Accepting FIND-SCALE for the research rung would unblock its audit without evidence.
findings.rationale: Acceptance of a real unresolved high finding without an accountable owner would be dishonest gating.

summary: Retype three requires edges to integration-requires so the bounded storage tasks can start against the recorded research decision while their audit pass still waits for RESEARCH-530 and OUTCOME-520 verification.
limitations: hard_dependencies counts only the three affected requires edges before and after; other metrics are counted from the plan files.
This replan changes no node scope; the storage implementation still must satisfy the research's four-part validation matrix before its audit.
